newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline flat but quiet, French strike loosens.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline flat but quiet, French strike loosens.

text.p: European gasoline markets were flat and listless on Friday and were unmoved by the French truckers' strike which appeared to be ending late in the day.
Officials reported drivers were starting to lift many of the remaining blockades at oil refineries and fuel depots. Nearly half of France's petrol stations had suffered shortages this week.
The Rotterdam barge market held at Thursday's levels of $215.00 a tonne for refinery product but $212.00 for storage material. December swaps held steady around $207.50 with January some $2.75 lower.
